entity.name: Dubai air taxi routes & flight times
entity.meta_description: Four launch vertiports: VDX at DXB (GCAA-certified 7 Jul 2026, world's first), Dubai Marina (under construction), Dubai Mall and Palm Jumeirah. First point-to-point flight took 17 minutes (Margham to DWC, 9 Nov 2025).
